# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge
We commit to a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free experience for everyone participating in this project.

## Our Standards
- Be considerate in speech and action.
- Offer and accept constructive feedback gracefully.
- Assume good intent and seek clarification before escalating.

## Scope
This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces and when representing the project in public spaces.

## Enforcement
Report unacceptable behavior to **[placeholder-email@example.com]** or **@placeholder-username** on GitHub. Reports will be reviewed promptly and kept as confidential as possible. Consequences may include warnings, temporary restrictions, or removal from participation where appropriate.

## Attribution
Portions inspired by the Contributor Covenant.
